items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I was fortunate when I went to London with Mr. Cook with the orchestra, through Mr. Jenkins, I shall never forget Edmund Jenkins

ctx.x: In what way, I mean, they'd --

In helping them to -- in the education and everything else, (Inaudible) Education and everything else they tried to -- and that's really what helped Mr. Jenkins and the way he was sponsored and helped, you see, to organize his --
Right. In other words he was getting -- most of his support was being raised by whites?

items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview

ctx.x: In Charleston. And what you call a preacher as well, just as Ol' Man Jenkins was.
